probes.title: Declared environment set (which environments this venture has)
probes.evidence: .agents/environments.json declares local, production environment(s) and no staging environment — this venture is production-only by decision, so the staging rehearsal is replaced by the production-shaped local rehearsal

probes.title: Deploy target (remote environments the product is published to)
probes.evidence:
Venture intake completed the configured read-only deployment preflight before repository provisioning.
[production] deploy_target=leet-deploy domain=hello-task.pengfeng.leettools.ai; controller admission passed

probes.title: Usage meter enforcing the declared spend ceilings
probes.evidence: no meter declared: .agents/budgets.json has no "meter".command and LEET_USAGE_METER_CMD is unset. The supervisor's meter, if any, is not readable from inside this workspace, so no invocation here can produce a meter reading.

probes.title: Telemetry sink (queryable destination for logs, metrics, traces)
probes.evidence: no OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, no GCP credentials for a provider-native sink, and no telemetry service in deploy/local/docker-compose.yml. Logs would be visible only on the host that runs the container.

probes.title: Product-analytics sink (adoption/activation events)
probes.evidence: no analytics write key in the environment (checked ANALYTICS_WRITE_KEY, POSTHOG_API_KEY, POSTHOG_PROJECT_API_KEY, SEGMENT_WRITE_KEY, AMPLITUDE_API_KEY) — nothing to send adoption events to
